<h2 class="hero-name">Priyabrata Saha</h2>

<div class="about">

<p>
I am an Assistant Professor in the <a href="https://ee.iitd.ac.in" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Department of Electrical Engineering</a> at the <a href="https://www.iitd.ac.in" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi</a>. My research interests lie broadly in applied machine learning, with applications in scientific computing, robotics, and control. I develop machine learning methods for modeling complex physical processes, learning-based optimization and control, and intelligent sensing in autonomous systems.
</p> 

<p>
Prior to joining IIT Delhi, I was an AI Research Scientist at <a href="https://www.rockwellautomation.com/en-us.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Rockwell Automation</a>, where I worked on integrating perception and control to advance industrial automation. 
Before that, I was a Postdoctoral Fellow at <a href="https://www.gatech.edu" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Georgia Tech</a>.
</p> 

<p>
I received my Ph.D. in Electrical and Computer Engineering from <a href="https://www.gatech.edu" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Georgia Tech</a>
in 2023, and my Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees in Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering from the <a href="https://www.iitkgp.ac.in" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Kharagpur</a> in 2015. 
At Georgia Tech, I conducted research under <a href="https://greenlab.ece.gatech.edu/members/professor/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Prof. Saibal Mukhopadhyay</a> on developing machine learning techniques for modeling and control of dynamical systems.
</p>

</div>
